content.name: Daniel Kowalski
content.title: 2nd Line IT Support Engineer
content.summary: 2nd line support engineer with nine years across an accountancy practice, a multi-academy trust and a law firm in Leeds. Led the move of 280 users to Intune-managed laptops and helped the firm pass Cyber Essentials Plus first time. ITIL 4 certified, calm with fee-earners on deadline and good at writing guides people actually read.

experience.title: 1st Line Support Analyst
bullets: Handled 35–45 calls and tickets a day for 120 staff, logging everything in Freshdesk against agreed SLAs.
Prepared laptops for the January self-assessment rush so every temporary staff member had a working machine on day one.
Wrote 40 knowledge-base articles that reduced repeat password and printer calls by about a quarter.

experience.title: 2nd Line Support Technician
bullets: Supported seven primary and secondary schools with 2,600 pupils, covering networks, interactive panels and the MIS.
Deployed 900 Chromebooks for remote learning in eight weeks during the 2020 school closures.
Moved the trust from on-site file servers to SharePoint and Teams, retiring four ageing servers.
Ran safeguarding-aware web filtering reviews with designated safeguarding leads every term.

experience.title: 2nd Line IT Support Engineer
bullets: Lead endpoint management for 280 users, migrating every laptop to Intune and Autopilot with BitLocker enforced.
Prepared device and patching evidence that helped the firm achieve Cyber Essentials Plus at the first assessment.
Cut average resolution time for 2nd line tickets from 2.1 days to 0.9 days by introducing triage categories and weekly backlog reviews.
Coach two 1st line analysts and run the onboarding session for new trainee solicitors each September.

education.degree: BTEC Level 3 Extended Diploma in Information Technology (Distinction*, Distinction, Distinction)

achievements.title: Trust staff recognition award
achievements.detail: Nominated by head teachers for the Chromebook rollout during school closures.

achievements.title: Volunteer, digital inclusion drop-in
achievements.detail: Help residents with online forms and video calls at a community centre in Harehills monthly.
